items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: That's, Clay Giles is Albert's uncle.

ctx.x: Is that Albert Giles' uncle or father?
That's, Clay Giles is Albert's uncle. Mm-hmm. I see. That's his uncle. Now, his daddy was, let's see. I can't think of his dad. 된된된 !

name. Well, we'll ask him. He'll know. Yeah. I can't think of his dad. I just want to get those guys. I can't think of his dad's name. I was going to ask about, in marching, the trombones are always out in front, but where does the tuba belong? Right with you or sometimes the tuba in back of you in the old days? Way back. Two supporters always be in the front. No, no, but some time ago the tuba used to be behind us because if you had two trombones, the tuba used to be back to the second. But now here up late, we…
